parameters.content:
# Smart Academic Attendance · n8n Standalone
**ONE workflow · ONE GET webhook** · No Vercel, no $vars, no external PDF converter.
Query parameter `action=` routes UI, data, PDF, Excel and CSV. All records are **SYNTHETIC**.

## Response types
- HTML = admin UI and print preview
- JSON = student, batch, health, errors
- Binary = academic/compliance **separate PDFs**, six-sheet `.xlsx`, `.csv`

**SECURITY:** NextAuth / Microsoft Entra is not ported. Secure before real student data.

parameters.content:
## VISA COMPLIANCE / LIVE DATA ONLY
1. In node 02, set the real Student Data API URL.
2. Connect HTTP Header Auth credentials to Student Data API.
3. Connect one Qwickly OAuth2 (Client Credentials, **Body** authentication) credential to all Qwickly HTTP nodes. Token URL: https://au.qwickly.tools/api/auth/token/ .
4. Connect a Header Auth credential to Webhook 01.
5. Test with GET ?sis_id=104404156&course_lms_id=2244.
6. No emulator fallback: missing/unmatched source records stop execution. A PDF is an administrative evidence packet, not an immigration decision.
7. PDF includes source reconciliation and detailed session appendix.

parameters.content:
## FULL CLASS ATTENDANCE XLSX
1. Configure the same Qwickly OAuth2 **Client Credentials** credential on every HTTP Request node.
2. Configure a Header Auth credential on Webhook 01.
3. Test with ?course_lms_id=2244; adjust to an authorised course.
4. Includes Summary, Full Attendance Logs, Session Index, Course Enrolments, Status Dictionary, Status Counts, Audit Metadata.
5. Every session and record page is requested; student names are resolved from course enrolments.
6. Export contains potentially sensitive educational records; restrict access and retention.
7. On pagination or item-pairing failure, execution stops rather than silently misattributing records.
